prompt: Cho tam giác <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>M</mi></semantics></math> là điểm thuộc cạnh <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math> sao cho <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>M</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>N</mi></semantics></math> là trung điểm của cạnh <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math>. Giả sử <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>a</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>, ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>N</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mover><mi>a</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mover><mi>b</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>. Khi đó tổng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math> bằng bao nhiêu?
solution:
Ta có
MN→=MC→+CN→=13BC→−12AC→=13⋅(AC→−AB→)−12AC→=−13AB→−16AC→=−13a→−16b→.
